latest_release.name: KTransformers v0.7.2
latest_release.body:
# KTransformers v0.7.2: DeepSeek-V4-Flash LoRA Fine-Tuning

KTransformers v0.7.2 adds LoRA fine-tuning for the April DeepSeek-V4-Flash checkpoint. Routed experts remain in native MXFP4 on CPU, while attention and other non-expert modules run on GPU.

## 🚀 Highlights

- Native MXFP4 routed-expert LoRA forward and backward, without expanding the frozen expert weights to BF16.
- LLaMA-Factory SFT integration with checkpoint saving and SGLang adapter inference.
- Python 3.11 and 3.12 Linux x86-64 wheels.

## 📦 Installation

For training:

```bash
python -m pip install 'ktransformers[sft]==0.7.2'
```

For inference:

```bash
python -m pip install 'ktransformers[sglang]==0.7.2'
```

## 🛠️ Main-Branch Updates
- [KTransformers-FineTune preprint v1.1](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/ktransformers/commit/6160538c81fc1d2cbc1952302a6d4b77a8adcd2e) upload and update our paper to the latest.
- [CPU BF16 gradient-norm reduction](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/ktransformers/commit/c76ff29b2aae025c6a9cb139f83426a1156c618c) adds a native sum-of-squares primitive for KT-owned gradients without materializing an FP32 tensor, which reduces the grad clip overhead of full fine-tuning.


## 🌟 Contributors

Thanks to all human code and documentation contributors since v0.7.1: @JimmyPeilinLi, @yyj6666667, @05yuki, @losewayy, @Dashener2, @pratikgx, @MohammadHijjawi97, and @Anai-Guo. Thanks also to everyone who reviewed and tested these changes.
